note: The bar, and what each growth event does to it. Magnitudes are placeholders pending the harness calibration in crown-demands.md section 8 - equal expected pressure across the reference players, which is measured rather than judged. gold_target is a revenue target over term_months, not a bill; it is meant to sit above what a young colony returns. The reach ceiling is seven because crown-demands.md section 6 wrote it as 'there are only so many people in the world with a hand out before M7 brings patrons' - M7 has brought them, so the last three hands are the three patrons, and the third rival duke becomes reachable on the way.
